title: Which country has the most meat per person? It's not America.
description:
Tonga has the most meat per person: about 157 kg a year in FAO's 2023 food balances, ahead of Mongolia (136), the Marshall Islands (126) and the United States (122). India has about 8 kg; DR Congo, last of 176 countries, about 3.5.

Sources:
- Meat supply per person (data download) — Our World in Data, from FAO Food Balances: https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/meat-supply-per-person.csv?v=1&csvType=full&useColumnShortNames=true
- Meat supply per person: definition and notes — Our World in Data: https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/meat-supply-per-person.metadata.json

Labels: FAO meat supply per person, 2023: meat available for consumption, not meat eaten; it does not correct for waste and excludes fish and seafood. 430 g a day is 157 kg ÷ 365.
